name: manual_68de10
claim: Receiver acceptance is not content-identity proof: ok, received_at and a matching byte count establish that a receiver accepted a transfer, not that the receiver holds the intended bytes. Treat delivery as content-verified only when the receiver reports or independently verifies a matching cryptographic digest; otherwise report accepted delivery with the content-identity limitation.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit PR 495 review found lesson_2e9ff8e7b1f4 conflated receiver acceptance and byte count with content identity; preserve the acceptance distinction while requiring digest evidence for verified content.

rationale: CodeRabbit PR 495 review found lesson_2e9ff8e7b1f4 conflated receiver acceptance and byte count with content identity; preserve the acceptance distinction while requiring digest evidence for verified content.
